mapper.insert: insert into file(user_id, storage_id, file_name, file_type, file_size, storage_engine, upload_time) values (#{userId}, #{storageId}, #{fileName}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{storageEngine}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update file SET file_name = #{fileName} where file_id = #{fileId} and user_id = #{userId}
